data.name: Elwin
data.gender_notes: Elwin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German name Aluwih, which consists of two parts: 'al' meaning ‘other’ or ‘all’ and ‘win’ meaning ‘friend’ or ‘kin’. It was common among the Germanic peoples and was brought to England by the early Anglo-Saxon settlers. The name Elwin can be interpreted as 'elf-friend' or 'friend of all'. The name Elwin carries the meaning “Elf friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elwin usually hope their child will grow to embody elf friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
